metro.name: Jaipur Metro
metro.note: Operational between Mansarovar and Badi Chaupar. Useful for reaching key parts of the city.

rail.name: Jaipur Junction (JP)
rail.note: Major railway station with trains from Delhi, Mumbai, Agra, and other cities across India.

rail.name: Gandhinagar Jaipur (GADJ)
rail.note: Secondary station on the Jaipur-Delhi route, useful for certain express trains.

airport.name: Jaipur International Airport (JAI)
airport.note: Domestic and limited international flights. Connected by taxi, app-cab and airport buses.

rail.name: Madgaon Junction (MAO)
rail.note: Main railway station for Konkan Railway. Major stop for express trains along the west coast.

rail.name: Thivim Railway Station (THVM)
rail.note: Convenient for North Goa beaches (Anjuna, Baga, Vagator). Auto-rickshaws and taxis readily available.

rail.name: Vasco da Gama Railway Station (VSG)
rail.note: Station near Mormugao Port; useful for some trains and connections.

airport.name: Manohar International Airport, Mopa (GOX)
airport.area: Mopa, North Goa, ~35 km from Panaji
airport.note: Newer airport serving domestic and international flights; has grown rapidly.

airport.name: Dabolim Airport (GOI)
airport.area: Dabolim, South Goa, ~30 km from Panaji
airport.note: Older airport, well connected to domestic and international destinations.

metro.name: Delhi Metro
metro.note: Extensive network covering most of Delhi NCR. Airport Express connects to IGI Airport.

rail.name: New Delhi Railway Station (NDLS)
rail.note: One of India's busiest railway stations with trains to all major cities.

rail.name: Old Delhi Railway Station (DLI)
rail.note: Historic station serving many north-bound trains; close to the old city.

rail.name: Hazrat Nizamuddin (NZM)
rail.note: Important station for south-bound and some long-distance trains.

airport.name: Indira Gandhi International Airport (DEL)
airport.note: One of India's busiest airports with three terminals. Connected by Airport Express Metro, taxis and buses.

rail.name: Joginder Nagar Railway Station (JDNX)
rail.note: Narrow-gauge station; scenic but limited connectivity. Most visitors reach via road.

rail.name: Chandigarh Junction (CDG)
rail.note: Nearest major broad-gauge station. From here take a bus or taxi to Manali (8-10 hours by road).

airport.name: Kullu–Manali Airport, Bhuntar (KUU)
airport.note: Domestic airport with limited flights (weather dependent). Connected by taxi; road journey takes ~1.5 hours.

metro.name: Varanasi Metro (under construction / partial)
metro.note: Metro network is expanding; currently limited coverage. Auto-rickshaws and e-rickshaws are widely used.

rail.name: Varanasi Junction (BSB)
rail.note: Major railway station with extensive connectivity across India. Well connected to the city by auto-rickshaw and taxi.

rail.name: Banaras Hindu University (BHU) Station
rail.note: Smaller station near the BHU campus, useful for some trains.

airport.name: Lal Bahadur Shastri International Airport (VNS)
airport.note: Domestic and international flights. Connected by pre-paid taxi, app-cab and buses to the city.
